text: This solution, State Disaster Mitigation Plan (SDMP), NSW Reconstruction Authority (NSW RA) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Australia (State of New South Wales) between NSW Reconstruction Authority, NSW Treasury, NSW Government agencies, Local councils, Industry (building code bodies), and Insurance sector. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, regulation, and raising awareness.
